preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 400,000.
The diameter d must be between 1 and 400,000.
The maximum degree k must be between 1 and 400,000.

postconditions.description: If it is impossible to construct the tree, output 'NO'. Otherwise, output 'YES' followed by n-1 lines of edges.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(edge.split()[0]) <= n and 1 <= int(edge.split()[1]) <= n for edge in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: All edges must connect vertices numbered from 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: len(set(edge.split()) for edge in stdout.splitlines()[1:]) == n - 1
postconditions.description: The number of unique edges must be exactly n-1.
